description: A provision for one case. With commenced (the day the case began): which later changes to the provision reach that case (from any scope the record holds, such as "cases commenced on or after"), and the text that applies to it, period by period. With decided (the day a court decided): is the text the court applied still the text in force (today, or on a date), and if not, which laws changed it and how. With neither: the judgments the record holds for the provision, each checked that way. Give both for a case that has a decision.

case_name.description: Optional, to label a decision in the answer.

commenced.description: The day the case (or matter) was commenced, YYYY-MM-DD: which changes reach it, and the text that applies.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

decided.description: The day a decision was made, YYYY-MM-DD: whether the text it applied is still in force.

include_period_texts.description: With commenced: also give the full text of every period (long); the changes between periods come anyway.

max_results.description: Recorded judgments to check, latest first (default 50, at most 500).

path.description: A provision file, for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11/1182.md, from find_provision.

name: case_check
title: Case check
